interest: Japanese purchases of U.S. phenol and sulphur, and export freedom in 1935.
overview: 1933–35 file on Mitsui phenol orders, Senator King's sulphur inquiry and a Japanese 'noiseless machine gun'.

people.name: Kenyon A. Joyce
people.role: Colonel, General Staff Corps; Assistant Chief of Staff, G-2/C-2, Headquarters Second Corps Area

people.name: William H. King
people.role: U.S. Senator from Utah; Chairman, Senate Committee on the District of Columbia

people.name: Warrington Dawson
people.role: Transmitter of intelligence report from Paris

subfiles.about: Colonel Kenyon A. Joyce forwards military intelligence concerning large-scale Japanese procurement orders for phenol placed with American firms.
subfiles.summary: G-2 reports that Mitsui and others ordered large amounts of U.S. phenol, including from Monsanto.
subfiles.title: Intelligence Memorandum on Japanese Purchases of Phenol
subfiles.to: Assistant Chief of Staff, G-2, War Department

subfiles.about: Senator William H. King inquires whether federal laws or regulations prohibit the commercial sale and exportation of western American sulphur deposits to Japan.
keywords: Senate Committee on the District of Columbia
subfiles.summary: Senator King asks Hull whether any law bars selling western sulphur to Japan.
subfiles.title: Letter from Senator William H. King Regarding Exportation of Sulphur to Japan

subfiles.about: Secretary of State Cordell Hull informs Senator King that there are no statutory or treaty restrictions on exporting sulphur from the United States to Japan.
subfiles.summary: Hull tells Senator King no law or treaty restricts sulphur exports.
subfiles.title: Letter from Secretary Cordell Hull to Senator William H. King on Sulphur Exports

subfiles.about: A State Department cross-reference sheet indexing a report from Paris by Warrington Dawson regarding an alleged Japanese noiseless machine gun invention.
subfiles.summary: Cross-reference to Dawson's report of a Japanese noiseless machine gun.
subfiles.title: Cross-Reference Sheet on Report of Japanese Noiseless Machine Gun
